label: early original-phase token after a y...0 prefix (sequence starting with y, digit 0 just before)
explanation: Sparse (~0.007% of steps) conjunctive feature that fires almost only in the original phase at t=2..5 (98% of mass; none at t<2, at the delimiter, and only a handful of copy steps at recall_idx 1). It fires on the token right after a 0 when the sequence began with y (or less often l), e.g. y y 0 [p], y 0 0 [r], k y 0 0 [h]. Strongest activations have prefix y/y0 followed by 0 and current token in {x,3,p,u,r,w,h,2,f}; prev_tok=0 carries 70% of mass, prev2 y/0 and first token y/l are strong modulators. The tight predicate is precise (~64% dev) but recalls only ~29%; looser versions (any y/l start with prev 0) reach ~59% recall at ~5% precision, because the feature is also gated by the identity of the current token and fires weakly on variants (prev token i/g, first token k/2/q with y at position 1). Does not fire on prefixes without y/l and 0.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=l (+4.36), prev_tok=0 (+4.23), orig0=y (+3.24), prev3_tok=y (+2.70), prev2_tok=y (+2.54), prev_tok=g (+2.39). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-3.29), prev2_tok=l (-2.01).
